en: Color postcard showing a large saucer-shaped fountain in a leafy park with red flowerbeds and a child in a stroller in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian text, a vertical "EDITURA MERIDIANE" imprint, caption lines naming Galați and "View of the park" in multiple languages, price in lei, and a Romanian 40 BANI stamp reading "POSTA ROMANA" with a socialist coat of arms and postmark.
